description.value: Fujiya is a Japanese grocery and deli chain celebrating over 50 years in BC, with the Victoria location on Shelbourne Street open since 1991. Operating as a takeout-only shop, it offers prepared Japanese foods including sushi sets, individual rolls, and grocery items. It is a compact, community-oriented stop well-suited to cyclists looking for a quick and distinctive Japanese meal to go.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 10m; rack (4 spaces) at 66m. Total: 8 spaces.
